notable_results: First mass-produced 1/5 gas buggy to succeed in the US (2006); the platform that effectively created the large-scale off-road class and remains a fixture at large-scale fun/race events. Flux variant is the 8S brushless version.
notes: Nominal 1/5 scale, RWD 2WD buggy. Sold as gas (23/26cc) kit/RTR or Flux 8S electric. The reference large-scale off-road platform.

notable_results: 1/5 truck variant of the Baja 5B (released 2008) with 26cc engine and truck body; widely run at large-scale off-road events alongside the 5B.
notes: Large-scale truck on the Baja 5 platform. Classed as off-road 'buggy' type per the schema (large-scale off-road).

notable_results: 1/5 large-scale short course truck on the Baja 5 platform; popular in large-scale SC bashing/club running.
notes: 1/5 gasoline short-course truck. SC-1 body. Off-road large-scale ('buggy' type per schema).

notable_results: Premier 1/5 4WD gas short-course race truck, ~3ft long with Zenoah G320 32cc engine; tire compound/tread optimized for racing. A staple of large-scale 4WD SC racing.
notes: 1/5 4WD gas short-course truck (Bind-N-Drive). Large-scale off-road racing ('buggy' type per schema). V2 is the current revision.

notable_results: Leading 1/5 4WD brushless desert buggy; 8S, 50+ mph, the go-to large-scale electric off-road platform for bashers and large-scale enthusiasts.
notes: 1/5 4WD brushless desert buggy. V2/Fox 8S variants current. Spektrum Firma 160A ESC + 780Kv motor.

notable_results: Gas-powered 1/5 4WD desert buggy (Icon variant); large-scale off-road counterpart to the DBXL-E.
notes: 1/5 4WD gas desert buggy. Gas sibling of the DBXL-E platform.

notable_results: FG's 1/5 large-scale on-road sedan/touring platform (26cc, belt-drive, ~100 km/h); FG is the dominant European 1/5 large-scale on-road brand with an established competition heritage (Competition / Sportsline lines).
notes: 1/5 large-scale on-road sedan => 'touring' type per schema. 5mm alloy chassis, 26cc engine, 4 oil-pressure shocks. FG also produces a Competition Touring line.

notable_results: Purpose-built comp-ready scale crawler kit ('lighter, lower, more adjustable'); has already won and placed at multiple events with designer Wyatt Mellon driving. A go-to comp/scale competition platform.
notes: 1/10 4WD comp-style scale crawler builder kit (AXI03028). Carbon-rail comp builds common with Hobbywing/Reefs/SSD components.

notable_results: Unlimited Trail Buggy with portal axles + 4-wheel steering; 45.37:1 final drive for max climbing. Widely cited as the platform to own for serious rock-crawling competition / technical comp driving.
notes: 1/10 UTB (Unlimited Trail Buggy) comp-trail crawler with portal axles + 4WS. RTR is brushed; comp builds run brushless. Crawler type.

notable_results: Dedicated competition rock-crawler kit (Associated Electrics' Element brand): carbon-fiber flat-rail chassis, portal axles, Stealth X overdrive transmission with 60/40 forward weight bias. Built specifically for the hardcore comp-crawling scene.
notes: 1/10 4WD dedicated competition crawler kit (ASC40129 / EL40129). Carbon chassis, portal axles, Stealth X trans. Manuals/setups hub linked.

notable_results: First platform with Vanquish's VFD Twin transmission (selectable overdrive + 3-position dig) and F10 portal axles; high-end scale/comp competition crawler kit.
notes: 1/10 scale-comp crawler kit. Phoenix (portal) and Origin (straight-axle) variants. VFD Twin trans with dig + overdrive.

notable_results: Competition-grade RTR comp rock crawler: stamped-aluminum frame, F10 portal axles, VFD trans at chassis low-point with 6.5% overdrive, low-CG brass weighting and pinched comp Lexan body.
notes: 1/10 comp rock crawler RTR (VPS09009 series). Portal axles, VFD trans, comp Stance body.

notable_results: Vanquish's dedicated 1/10 competition rock crawler kit (carbon-spec), one of the leading hardcore comp platforms in the current scene.
notes: 1/10 competition rock crawler kit (VPS09015). Carbon chassis comp rig.

notable_results: Competition-proven 'mullet' configuration comp crawler kit (front F10 straight axle + rear F10 portal); Carbon Spec VFD trans, 34% total overdrive for comp climbing/steering balance.
notes: 1/10 competition rock crawler kit (VPS09014). Front straight / rear portal 'mullet' layout.

notable_results: Performance-oriented scale/comp builder chassis used widely by scale enthusiasts and competition crawlers; Pro44 axles, full machined-steel drivetrain, 44.2:1 final drive.
notes: 1/10 scale/comp builders chassis (SSD00300). SSD components are common on competition SCX10 Pro / scale comp builds.

notable_results: Classic dual-motor MOA (motor-on-axle) competition crawler developed to meet U.S.R.C.C.A. competition rules; titanium links, carbon chassis, 2.2 comp beadlocks with X2SS compound tires. A long-standing benchmark of the dedicated comp-crawler class.
notes: 1/10-ish 2.2 dual-motor MOA competition crawler kit (RC4ZK0056). Built to USRCCA comp rules. The archetypal 'comp crawler' (vs scale comp).

notable_results: 1/10 LCG competition RTR rock crawler; brushless, low-center-of-gravity comp-oriented platform aimed at the competitive rock-crawling class.
notes: 1/10 4WD LCG brushless competition RTR crawler (RER31524). Lower-cost comp-class entry.
